terms.gloss: a nerd, a socially awkward person (fem. inconcinna)
terms.comment: The classical adjective means awkward, inelegant: quī in aliquō genere inconcinnus … est, is ineptus dīcitur (Cic. de Or. 2.17, Lewis & Short); the noun for a nerd is Traupman’s.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 350.
